title: Certified compliance digests with tenant pulse delivery
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a tenant-scoped compliance digest product that produces tamper-evident PDF and CSV artifacts ("certified digests") and delivers them on a configurable cadence (daily/weekly/monthly). Digests must include residency-scoped evidence, retention metadata, cryptographic manifests signed with KMS keys, and a lightweight tenant 'pulse' summary that can be pushed to webhooks, SFTP endpoints, or emailed as a short report. Goal: reduce manual audit work, support regional residency contracts, and provide verifiable proof-of-delivery for SOC/ISO auditors.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant can configure digest cadence and format (PDF, CSV, or both) per-tenant or per-project
Generated PDFs include a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) and a visible tamper-evidence stamp with signature reference
Digest generation respects residency filters and excludes data outside selected regions
Delivery supports webhook, SFTP with key exchange, and signed email attachments via transactional service
Audit log entry is created for each digest (who requested, generated_at, delivery_result) and is queryable in Console
Retention metadata included in each artifact; artifacts older than tenant retention policy are not delivered
Delivery retry/backoff implemented with SLA-aware escalation emails to tenant owners
End-to-end testbench exists that validates generation, signature verification, and delivery for staging tenants
tasks: Spec: finalize PDF template, CSV schema, and manifest structure (design + compliance)
Backend: implement residency-aware extraction pipeline with streaming CSV writer
Signing: integrate KMS signing for manifests and generate verifiable signature metadata
Delivery: add webhook/SFTP/email delivery adapters with delivery status callbacks
Console: add 'Digests' tab for configuring cadence, retention, and delivery endpoints
Observability: add digest success/failure metrics and per-tenant delivery logs
E2E: build staging tests to verify signature verification and residency filtering
Docs: update compliance runbook and tenant-facing setup guide

We should support both org-managed and customer-managed keys for signing to satisfy higher compliance tiers.
Retention policy enforcement must run at generation time to avoid accidental disclosure of expired records.
